blurb:
Miami's location provides convenient access to the warm waters of the Gulf Stream and some of South Florida's most exciting offshore fishing. Your private group will head into the Atlantic with an experienced local captain who selects fishing areas and techniques based on seasonal patterns and what's active.

Depending on the season and conditions, opportunities may include mahi-mahi, wahoo, kingfish, tuna, sailfish, swordfish, sharks, and other offshore species. With such a diverse fishery, every trip has the potential to offer a different experience.

What truly sets this charter apart is the combination of offshore adventure and an iconic Miami setting. From powerful game fish and deep blue Atlantic water to views of the Miami coastline, this private charter delivers a personalized deep sea fishing experience that showcases an exciting side of South Florida beyond the beaches
